sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG handoff hints — Driver education, permits and fees

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A01
Utah classroom hours are 27 for high school, 18 for commercial or private school, and 30 for approved online or home study [A01]
Why it matters: group driver-education-hours; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec03-R02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A80
The driving-instruction requirement is six hours behind the wheel. Six hours of observation by a licensed instructor may also be required by the school [A80].
Why it matters: group driver-education-hours; prereq sec03-R01; difficulty 1; confusable sec03-R01.
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A81
Drivers aged 15 to 18 must finish approved driver education and log 40 hours with a parent or guardian, with 10 hours after sunset [A81]
Why it matters: group age-paths; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec03-R04.
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A82
Drivers 19 or older may skip driver education by holding a learner permit 90 days and logging 40 hours with 10 hours after sunset [A82]
Why it matters: group age-paths; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec03-R03.
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A83
A learner permit stays in immediate possession while driving and the front-seat supervisor must be a licensed driver [A83]
Why it matters: group permit-supervision; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec03-R06.
Source: [A83 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A84
Holding periods are 6 months at age 16 or 17, none at age 18 with driver education, and 90 days at age 19 or older [A84]
Why it matters: group holding-periods; prereq sec03-R04; difficulty 2; confusable sec03-R05.
Source: [A84 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0017]
